sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Naval Academy Award of Degrees Amendment Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXIV OF 1983
ORDINANCE XXIV OF 1983
PAKISTAN NAVAL ACADEMY (AWARD OF DEGREES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Naval Academy (Award of
Degrees) Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary,. Part I, 5th October, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Pakistan Naval Academy (Award of Degrees) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 3, Ordinance XX of 1965

ORDINANCE XXIV OF 1983
ORDINANCE XXIV OF 1983
PAKISTAN NAVAL ACADEMY (AWARD OF DEGREES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Naval Academy (Award of
Degrees) Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary,. Part I, 5th October, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 3, Ordinance XX of 1965.---In the Pakistan
Naval Academy (Award of Degrees) Ordinance, 1965 (XX of 1965), in section 3,
after the brackets, letters and comma "(NA),", the words, letters,
brackets and commas "or the degree. of Bachelor of Arts, abbreviation
whereof shall be B.A. (NA)," shall be inserted.
